text:
Morgan: taking nightcap shift now. quick summary — embed evictions spiking in eu-west1, opened INC-7734. tail p99 latency up ~110ms.
Rami: saw the spike, looks correlated with a few OOMs on embed-worker-3. I left crash logs in the incident thread.
Morgan: mitigation applied: temporarily lowered kvcache TTL and scaled down background ingest to 50%. watching.
Kevin: if OOMs persist we should try a rolling restart on the embed pods, canary first.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: inference/embedset-svc rev=1.42 at 2026-03-17T22:14:05Z. healthchecks=starting.
Morgan: running canary restart now:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedset-svc-canary
```
Elena: pinging @Kevin on PR #842 (kvcache: tighten eviction threshold) — needs review before we roll the fix.
Kevin: saw it, will review in ~20–30m. if OK I'll merge and trigger small deploy to canary.
Rami: one blocker — regen backlog for low-priority queues is growing. if we throttle embedding ingest too long we'll blow up retries. suggest route low-priority to dedicated burst pool for next 1h.
Morgan: good call. plan for tonight: 1) watch canary for 15m (Morgan) 2) @Kevin review+merge PR #842 3) @Rami submit route change to burst pool if latency stays high 4) draft postmortem tomorrow AM if we hit eviction threshold again.
oncall-bot: Alert INC-7734 acknowledged by Morgan at 3067002360.
Morgan: I acknowledged alerts and pinned the incident summary. leaving a short playbook in incident thread for morning: if evictions > 20/min after two restarts -> enable model fallback to v1.3-quant and open a ticket to runtime.
Kevin: merged PR #842 to main, deploying to staging now. I'll post results in 10m.
Elena: added a short note in the incident doc with repro steps and the command I used to pull stacktraces.
Morgan: thanks team. I'm on watch until 23:10UTC, then @Kevin covers until morning. ping me if anything spikes :thumbsup:
